data.one_liner: Get real phone number from Android device.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to retrieve the phone number or a list of phone numbers from an Android device. It supports checking platform support, checking permissions, and requesting permissions before retrieval.
use_when: You need to retrieve the user's phone number on Android
You want to handle permissions natively through the package interface
avoid_when: You need to support platforms other than Android
You are running tests on an emulator without real device support
strengths: Built-in permission handling and platform support checks
weaknesses: Requires a real device to function properly
data.setup_notes: Works only on Android and requires running on a real device. May require runtime permissions.
data.minimal_example:
String phoneNumber = await GetPhoneNumber().get();
print('getPhoneNumber result: $phoneNumber');
